=== Day 1: the town meeting ===
Edda: "No sense keeping the lid on the pot when the kitchen's smoking. I am the Rumormonger."
Edda: "The night before you arrived, I heard that one of Merrin and Odette is Marked, and may read as evil."  [case board: #23, #24]
Merrin: "Let the heavens bear witness before the fiend strikes me down in my bed—I am the Surveyor!"
Merrin: "The night before you arrived, I learned that not everyone living on the Square shares the same alignment."  [case board: #25, #26]
Odette: "Since we are doing public confessions today, let's get mine over with: I am the Archivist."

  the Square   (Drowned Lamb tavern, town well): Isolde & Edda talking at town well

  the Docks    (wharf, mill, Nisha's cottage): Merrin working at wharf
